verdict.rationale: Scheduled monitors with alerting are a fair question for an API client, but the evidence only shows that the Bruno CLI runs collections on demand, produces JSON/JUnit/HTML reports, and can be wired into CI/CD pipelines or Docker. Scheduling those runs and alerting on failure would depend on an external CI scheduler, which is a host-platform workaround rather than Bruno's own capability. Nothing in the pack documents a built-in monitor, recurring schedule, or alert feature, and the product is described as offline-only with no cloud service.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule collection runs as monitors that alert me when an API breaks
